imagem.description: The image FROZEN at `imageVersion`, resolved from the `artifact.project_image` event at that exact version — never the current one, which may have been revised since. `null` when that version's event could not be found.

pidsLimit.description: Process cap. This is what contains a fork bomb without depending on a verb allowlist.

observado.description: What the broker reports right now — `null` either because there is no container, because it could not be asked (`naoObservado`), or because this row was not asked this load (`naoVerificado`).

estado.description: The daemon's own state, with no translation and no collapse.

iniciadoEm.description: `null` when the container has never started.

naoVerificado.description: Non-null when this row was NOT asked of the broker this load — never confused with `naoObservado`, which means it WAS asked and failed. `fora_do_escopo_da_verificacao`: status is `stopped`/`failed`/`removed`, where daemon confirmation does not matter. `teto_de_verificacoes_atingido`: eligible, but the per-load broker call budget was already spent by other rows.

acaoPendente.description: The pending `container_start`/`container_stop`/`container_remove` action for this project, if any — in ANY of its sessions. The page renders the inline `ApprovalCard` for it instead of the action button, same pattern as the PRs tab.

seq.description: Order of the action within the session; used as a cursor in listings.

actionType.description: What the action would do. `git_push` and `git_merge` require `maintainer`.

payload.description: Parameters of the action, specific to the `actionType`.

status.description: State in the pipeline. `auto_approved` is distinct from `approved` on purpose: the log needs to distinguish what a person decided from what the policy released.

resolvedPolicy.description: What `permissions.json` decided for this action. `deny` ALWAYS wins over `allow` — not even the agent's autonomy overrides it.

id.description: The user's id when `kind=user`; the agent's slug when `kind=agent`.

decidedBy.description: Id of the user who approved or denied it. Never an agent.

executionResult.description: Execution result, with a shape specific to each `actionType` — output and exit code for terminal, PR number and URL for the git types. `null` while the action has not been executed.

401.description: No token, expired token, or invalid signature.

404.description: Workspace doesn't exist or is invisible to the caller.

429.description: Rate limit per user or per IP.
